title: Taming the Agentic RAN: Stability-Guaranteed Arbitration of Autonomous AI Agents in O-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2609.18857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The O-RAN control plane is becoming agentic: autonomous AI agents, deployed as rApps by different vendors, independently close control loops over shared radio resources. We demonstrate on a live O-RAN system that this independence is unsafe. Two agents with individually correct objectives, one protecting a latency SLA and one maximizing utilization for energy efficiency, jointly drive recurring opposing excursions of the shared resource partition that neither produces alone. Existing conflict-mitigation mechanisms presume a statically known application population and cannot govern agents whose behavior emerges at run time. We present AURA, a lightweight arbitration layer that admits agent actions only when they satisfy feasibility invariants, per-variable dwell times, and a deadband, and we prove the arbitrated system converges to a feasible operating point. Implemented on an OpenAirInterface (OAI) testbed with measured one-way latency

translated_title: 驯服代理化无线接入网：O-RAN中自主AI代理的稳定性保障仲裁
translated_abstract: O-RAN（开放无线接入网）的控制平面正变得代理化：由不同供应商部署为rApp的自主AI代理，独立地对共享的无线资源闭合控制回路。我们在一个真实的O-RAN系统上演示了这种独立性是不安全的。两个各自目标都正确的代理——一个保护时延SLA，另一个为提升能效而最大化资源利用率——共同引发了共享资源分区的反复对立波动，而这种波动是任何单独一方都不会产生的。现有的冲突缓解机制假定应用群体是静态已知的，无法治理其行为在运行时涌现的代理。我们提出了AURA，一个轻量级仲裁层，只有当代理动作满足可行性不变量、每变量驻留时间和死区条件时才允许其执行，并且我们证明了经仲裁后的系统会收敛到一个可行的运行点。该系统在OpenAirInterface（OAI）测试床上实现，实测单向时延
tldr: 本文提出AURA轻量级仲裁层，通过可行性不变量、驻留时间和死区机制约束O-RAN中多个自主AI代理对共享无线资源的控制行为，并从理论上证明仲裁后的系统能够收敛到可行运行点，解决了多厂商rApp在真实O-RAN系统中独立闭环控制引发的资源冲突问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AURA, a lightweight arbitration layer that only admits agent actions satisfying feasibility invariants, per-variable dwell times, and a deadband, and proves the arbitrated system converges to a feasible operating point, addressing unsafe conflicts among independently-controlled autonomous AI agents in live O-RAN systems.
